Quests: id -> {title, giver (canon NPC), offer, gate? {flags, not_flags, days, min_band}, fail? {flags, after_day}, steps [{text, flag} or {text, did {action, outcome?, context?}, count?}], rewards? {relationship, coins, goods {good: n}, flags}, done?, confidence, canon_ref?, note?}. The giver dying fails a quest. Own words only, no book quotes. M33.3 adds three lines: Erin's inn, Pawn's Soldiers, Pisces's mana lesson.

erin_gets_the_inn_going.title: Getting the inn going
erin_gets_the_inn_going.offer: The place is a mess and I have no idea what I am doing. Help me fix it up, cook, and keep it open?

steps.text: Repair a table or chair in the inn.
Cook three meals in the inn kitchen.
Wash dishes or sweep the floor twice.
Wait until the first regular guests come to the inn.
Tell Erin the inn is ready.

erin_gets_the_inn_going.done: Look at it! Tables, food, a few guests. It is a real inn now. Take this, you earned it.

canon_ref.note: Erin repairs and names the inn and gets her first regulars (days 13 - 15).

erin_gets_the_inn_going.note: A made-up task that follows the canon days of the inn becoming a real place.

pawn_and_the_painted_soldiers.title: Pawn's Soldiers
pawn_and_the_painted_soldiers.offer: My Soldiers are strong, but they are hungry and have never seen the sky. Will you help me look after them?

steps.text: Cook three meals for the Soldiers at the inn.
Talk with Pawn about his Soldiers twice.
Wait until the old Drakes cheer the painted Soldiers in Liscor.
Wait until the Workers finish the inn's new floor.
Tell Pawn how the Soldiers are doing.

pawn_and_the_painted_soldiers.done: They march in the sun now, and they pray. I think this is what I wanted for them. Thank you.

canon_ref.note: Pawn leads the painted Soldiers above ground (day 82), they march in Liscor (101), the Workers finish the inn (112).

pawn_and_the_painted_soldiers.note: A made-up task that follows Pawn's canon days.

pisces_teaches_mana.title: Pisces and the mana lesson
pisces_teaches_mana.offer: You cannot cast, and I will not waste my breath on a person who cannot feel mana. Show you can learn, and I will teach you a harder spell.

steps.text: Talk with Pisces about mana twice.
Cook a meal for Pisces's tab.
Wait until Pisces tests mana in the inn.
Play a game of chess in the inn.

pisces_teaches_mana.done: Hm. You feel mana better than I thought. Come, I will show you a spell that needs it.

canon_ref.note: Pisces trades lessons for Erin's tab (days 23 - 24) and tests Erin and Rags with his own mana (34 - 35).

pisces_teaches_mana.note: A made-up task. Its reward flag unlocks [Flash Step] from Pisces (spells.json learn.flags).
